newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: AVMIN KONKOLA DEAL MAY BE SIGNED THIS WEEK.
newsitem.headline: AVMIN KONKOLA DEAL MAY BE SIGNED THIS WEEK.

text.p: Zambia Finance Minister Ronald Penza said on Monday an option agreement with Avmin Ltd on the development on Konkola North mine could be signed this week.
"The deal should have been signed last week, but was set back because of the funeral of (transport and communications) minister Paul Kapinga," Penza told Reuters in an interview.
"The agreement will probably be signed this week," he added.
The development of the Konkola ore body on the Zambian Copperbelt is seen as crucial to the future of the country's mining industry.

Last month, a consortium led by Zambia Copper Investments, a subsidiary of Anglo American Corp of South Africa , signed an agreement with the Zambian government on the development of Konkola Deep mine.
Avmin, the minerals division of the South African mining house Anglovaal , said last year it was targeting to delineate ore resources at Konkola North of not less than 100 million tonnes.
Avmin is also leading a consortium bid for the prized Nkana and Nchanga divisions of Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM), which account for half of the national copper output.
